itemized.notes: THE ONE DISPUTED DIGIT ON THIS FILING, AND HOW IT WAS SETTLED: Schedule A page 4 row 4 and its page subtotal both end in a cents group that reads 25 or 75 at base resolution. Read as 25 the filing does not close (3,663.68 + 4,798.25 = 8,461.93 against a printed TOTAL of 8,462.43). Read as 75 it closes exactly on BOTH sides - the A subtotal, the A total, the stated contribution total, and the matching 148.75 expenditure that is the whole content of Schedule B's second page. The arithmetic, not the glyph, is what fixed 148.75 / 4,798.75. Schedule A spans PDF pages 3-4 (form pages 2 and 3 of 5) and Schedule B PDF pages 5-6 (form pages 4 and 5 of 5). REDACTION: on PDF page 3 the whole Complete Mailing Address column is covered by a white block, so those rows carry blank city/state marked redacted; page 4's addresses are visible and were reduced to city/state at read time. Two Schedule A rows are AGGREGATE lines reading 'CONTRIBUTIONS UNDER $50' rather than a donor name - kept verbatim, never attributed. The candidate reimburses herself repeatedly, so several Schedule A rows have an identical mirrored Schedule B row; one in-kind pair (BILL PAULOS, 2,000.00 consulting) appears on both sides and both sides count toward the printed totals.
